post.description:
Receives Pay2S webhook when a deposit transaction arrives at the system bank account.
Validates Authorization: Bearer {SecretKey} header against tokenWebhook stored in system_bank_accounts.
Matches transfer content to identify the donor, then publishes to Kafka for async processing.

Receives Pay2S webhook for streamer donation bank accounts.
The token path parameter identifies the streamer: /webhooks/pay2s/donation/{token}
The token is matched against SchedulerBank.TokenWebhook to identify the streamer.
Publishes to Kafka for async processing (transaction recording + OBS alert).

referenceId.description:
ID của đối tượng bị báo cáo (challenge ID, transaction ID, ...).
Bắt buộc khi reportType = "challenge_fraud".

contentFormat.description:
ContentFormat shows the pattern written into the QR addInfo and matched
against Pay2S webhook content. {donorCode} is a unique 8-char hex per donor.
Example: "SHOPVPS{donorCode}VNDSHOPVPS"

prefix.description:
Prefix is the keyword admin configured (e.g. "SHOPVPS").
It appears on both sides of the donor code in the transfer content.

supportedCurrencies.description: SupportedCurrencies lists the currencies that can be deposited.

addInfo.description:
AddInfo is the full formatted transfer content to write when transferring.
Format: {prefix}{donorCode}{currency}{prefix}  e.g. "SHOPVPS4A3F1B2CGEMSHOPVPS"

depositCode.description: DepositCode is the donor's unique 8-char identifier embedded in AddInfo.

supportedCurrencies.description: SupportedCurrencies lists the currencies that can be deposited.

prefix.description:
Prefix is the keyword that wraps the donor code in the transfer content.
e.g. "SHOPVPS" → transfer content becomes "SHOPVPS4A3F1B2CVNDSHOPVPS"

supportedCurrencies.description: SupportedCurrencies is the list of currencies currently allowed for deposit.

userMediaURL.description: S3 URL of donor's purchased asset

voiceURL.description: Donor content overrides (non-empty based on MessageType)
